faqs.q: Sec. 2-2. - Policy for adoption of intergovernmental agreements.
faqs.a:
(1)
Intergovernmental agreements (IGA's) shall be adopted by ordinance if:
(a)
The IGA establishes new or significantly different responsibilities for any employee
               or work unit of the city; or
(b)
The execution or implementation of the IGA requires funding in excess of $5,000,000.00;
               or
(c)
The IGA is for extraordinary duration in excess of five years; or
(d)
The IGA establishes new or extraordinary legal liabilities for the city.
(2)
Intergovernmental agreements shall be adopted by resolution if:
(a)
The IGA merely facilitates existing responsibilities or duties of an employee or work
               unit of the city; or
(b)
The IGA is an extension or minor modification of an existing IGA; or
(c)
The IGA does not require new funding.
(3)
The process for adopting intergovernmental agreements shall include:
(a)
In no instance shall an intergovernmental agreement be placed upon a consent agenda.
(b)
The presiding officer shall inquire if members of the public present at the council
               meeting wish to speak to the intergovernmental agreement prior to city council voting
               on such matter.
(
Ord. No. 4330, § 1, 4-2-2012
;
Ord. No. 4897
, §§ 1—3, 6-3-2025)
Editor's note—
Ordinance No. 4330, § 1, adopted April 2, 2012
, did not specifically amend the Code. Therefore, such ordinance has been added as
               § 2-2 at the editor's discretion.
